source: Virtual Fly Brain VFBquery HTTP API (https://v3-cached.virtualflybrain.org/), FlyWire FAFB v783 connectome; class-aggregated connectivity (grouped /query_connectivity, 1,469 rows on retry — the 0-row result during the mating build was API degradation), edge weight = total synapse count

behavior.text: Courtship integration output: pC1 (doublesex, male) is the convergence node of the social brain — courtship song (JO-B->AMMC-B1->vPN1->pC1) and the P1 mating drive (P1->pC1) meet here. pC1 fans out to the fru courtship system, back to P1 itself, and directly to descending motor neurons.
behavior.basis: pC1 as the courtship-integration center is textbook Drosophila (Zhou et al 2015; Ishikawa et al 2023); edges below are the resolved API walk, stated as measured wiring

fly_narration: She sings, he hears — and the circuit answers.
honest_note: THE LOOP CLOSES. pC1->P1 (tw=5,863) is REAL measured wiring: the song chain (song_lit.json) ends at pC1, and pC1 drives P1 (mating.json) — courtship hearing feeds the mating drive through measured synapses, not just literature. pC1->pIP10 (tw=1,796) is also real (below top-k, recorded here). pC1->descending (tw=14,529) is pC1's direct motor output. pC1->fruitless-expressing (tw=87,164) feeds BACK into the fru system — the triple-convergence node is both upstream and downstream of pC1 (recurrent within the fru courtship system). Hop-1 takes top-6 specific + P1 as deliberate 7th; duplicated tiers by most specific member; 'sexually-dimorphic neuron' (47,894) skipped as parent bucket (mating precedent). CIRCUIT VS DYNAMICS: every edge is REAL measured wiring of pC1's output chain. How pC1 integrates song + pheromone + internal state into a courtship decision is the unmapped frontier; no API holds it and this graph models none of it. 2026-10-15 RETRY SWEEP: SMPad1 (FBbt_00050245) — pC1's honest hop-1 terminal — is HEALED via the label form (1,372 rows; grouped ID still dies server-side). Its downstream makes pc1.json CYCLIC: SMPad1->pC1 (tw=10,802) is a TRUE RECURRENT edge (hop-1 -> hop-0), and SMPad1 feeds the fru triple-convergence node (63,139), aSP-a, descending motor, and three new nodes (fru aDT-b, posterior-brain descending, fru pMP-e). The pC1 loop is now a recurrent social circuit, not a chain.
